turns.style: An alien commander at headquarters, heard over a long-distance radio link, speaking Egyptian Arabic, Cairo dialect, not Modern Standard Arabic. Deep, low, heavy voice, slow and flat. He asks short questions, unimpressed, with no warmth and no hurry.
